entity_reviews.llm_reasoning: The paper explicitly identifies the target material as graphitic carbon nitride, denoted g-C3N4 (e.g., Introduction: “Graphitic-carbon nitride, hereafter referred to as g-C3N4”; Experimental Section 2.1: “graphitic-C3N4@carbon paper”). This directly supports the target formula C3N4 (as part of g-C3N4).

In Experimental Section 2.1 (Preparation of Cathode), the text explicitly states: “a gelating solution was prepared by mixing 2.85 g of N-methylpyrrolidone (NMP) …”. This directly supports the extracted chemical identity (N-methylpyrrolidone) and amount (2.85 g).

In Experimental Section 2.1 (Preparation of Cathode), the text states that a gelating solution was prepared by mixing “2.85 g of N-methylpyrrolidone (NMP) with 0.15 g of polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) ...”. This explicitly supports the extracted chemical identity (polyvinylidene fluoride) and amount (0.15 g).

In Experimental Section 2.1 (Preparation of Cathode), the text explicitly states that the gelating solution was prepared by mixing 2.85 g NMP with 0.15 g PVDF and 0.2 g of guanidine hydrochloride (GundCl). This directly supports the extracted identity and amount.

The paper explicitly identifies the substrate material as carbon paper in Experimental Section 2.1: “Carbon papers were dipped in the above solution… Finally, the GCN@CPs were obtained…”. No quantitative amount/mass/area of carbon paper used in the dipping/calcination step is given anywhere in Section 2.1 (only amounts for NMP, PVDF, and guanidine hydrochloride are specified). Thus, 'carbon paper | Amount: Not specified in text' is consistent with the source.

Section 2.1 explicitly states the samples were calcined “under Ar flow,” confirming the chemical identity is argon (Ar). However, no quantitative amount/flow rate/pressure of Ar is provided anywhere in the supplied text, so “Amount: Not specified in text” is correct.

The paper explicitly specifies DMSO as part of the electrolyte in Section 2.3: “an electrolyte (DMSO-0.5 M LiClO4...)”. Therefore, the amount is not “not specified”; it is given as DMSO with 0.5 M LiClO4 (a concentration specification).
entity_reviews.llm_suggested_fix: dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) | Amount: electrolyte specified as “DMSO–0.5 M LiClO4” (i.e., 0.5 M LiClO4 in DMSO)

entity_reviews.llm_reasoning: In Experimental Section 2.3 (Electrochemical Investigation), the electrolyte is explicitly stated as “DMSO-0.5 M LiClO4…”, i.e., lithium perchlorate at 0.5 M concentration.
